qe: Before gaining prominence as an all-India leader, Subhash Chandra Bose served as the president of which provincial political organization?
qh: अखिल भारतीय नेता के रूप में प्रसिद्धि पाने से पहले, सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने किस प्रांतीय राजनीतिक संगठन के अध्यक्ष के रूप में कार्य किया था?
o: Bengal Provincial Congress Committee
Bombay Presidency Association
Madras Mahajan Sabha
Poona Sarvajanik Sabha
e: Detailed Explanation: Subhash Chandra Bose served as the president of the Bengal Provincial Congress Committee, where his primary focus was organizing the youth and expanding the trade union movement.

qe: Which political organization was established by Subhash Chandra Bose alongside Jawaharlal Nehru to advocate for absolute independence when older leaders favored dominion status?
qh: जब पुराने नेता डोमिनियन स्टेटस के पक्ष में थे, तब पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता की वकालत करने के लिए सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने जवाहरलाल नेहरू के साथ मिलकर किस राजनीतिक संगठन की स्थापना की थी?
o: Independence League
Forward Bloc
Swarajist Party
Indian League
e: Detailed Explanation: Dissatisfied with the Motilal Nehru Report's recommendation for dominion status, Subhash Chandra Bose and Jawaharlal Nehru organized the Independence League to demand complete independence.

qe: Subhash Chandra Bose vehemently opposed the signing of the Gandhi-Irwin Pact in 1931 primarily because the colonial government refused to compromise on which critical issue?
qh: सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने 1931 में गांधी-इरविन समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर करने का कड़ा विरोध मुख्य रूप से किस महत्वपूर्ण मुद्दे पर औपनिवेशिक सरकार के समझौता न करने के कारण किया था?
o: The death sentence of Bhagat Singh and his associates
The immediate abolition of the salt tax monopoly
The representation of depressed classes in legislatures
The dynamic introduction of provincial autonomy lists
e: Detailed Explanation: Bose was highly critical of the suspension of the Civil Disobedience Movement and the 1931 pact because the British administration flatly refused to negotiate on or commute the death sentences of Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev, and Rajguru.

qe: At the annual Congress session held at Haripura, Gujarat, in February 1938, Subhash Chandra Bose achieved what organizational milestone?
qh: फरवरी 1938 में हरिपुरा, गुजरात में आयोजित वार्षिक कांग्रेस अधिवेशन में सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने कौन सी संगठनात्मक उपलब्धि हासिल की थी?
o: He was unanimously elected as the President of the session
He formally announced his complete retirement from active politics
He established the Forward Bloc as a separate radical party
He dissolved the Bengal Provincial Congress Committee framework
e: Detailed Explanation: In February 1938, at the Haripura session in Gujarat, Subhash Chandra Bose was unanimously elected as the President of the Indian National Congress.

qe: In his 1938 Haripura presidential address, what progressive assessment did Subhash Chandra Bose outline regarding the Congress ministries running the provinces?
qh: अपने 1938 के हरिपुरा अध्यक्षीय भाषण में, सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने प्रांतों को चलाने वाले कांग्रेस मंत्रालयों के संबंध में क्या प्रगतिशील मूल्यांकन प्रस्तुत किया था?
o: He firmly believed that the provincial ministries possessed immense revolutionary potential
He declared that the ministries had completely outlived their baseline utility
He urged all popular premiums to immediately surrender their executive portfolios
He recommended that provincial budgets be placed under the direct control of the princes
e: Detailed Explanation: In his presidential address at Haripura, Bose expressed a firm belief that the newly formed Congress provincial ministries carried immense revolutionary potential for the freedom struggle.

qe: To map out the systematic economic development of India through state planning, Subhash Chandra Bose was instrumental in establishing which specialized body during his presidency?
qh: राज्य नियोजन के माध्यम से भारत के व्यवस्थित आर्थिक विकास का खाका तैयार करने के लिए, सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने अपनी अध्यक्षता के दौरान किस विशेष निकाय की स्थापना में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई थी?
o: National Planning Committee
Decentralization Commission
Foreign Cloth Boycott Committee
Swarajya Sabha Council
e: Detailed Explanation: Strongly advocating for planned economic development, Bose was instrumental in setting up the National Planning Committee during his tenure as Congress president.

qe: What policy decision did the 1938 Haripura Congress session officially resolve regarding popular agitations erupting within the native Princely States?
qh: देशी रियासतों (Princely States) के भीतर भड़कने वाले जन आंदोलनों के संबंध में 1938 के हरिपुरा कांग्रेस सत्र ने आधिकारिक तौर पर क्या नीतिगत निर्णय लिया था?
o: The Congress would extend moral support to those agitating against governance in the princely states
The absolute military prohibition barring any nationalist intervention in the states
The mandatory structural merging of all states with the British provinces immediately
To provide financial credit subsidies to protect the rulers from peasant agitations
e: Detailed Explanation: The Haripura session adopted an important resolution declaring that the Congress would officially extend its moral support to democratic movements and agitations against the autocratic governance inside the princely states.

qe: When Subhash Chandra Bose decided to stand again for the post of Congress President in January 1939, which candidate was officially backed by Mahatma Gandhi and the conservative working committee?
qh: जब सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने जनवरी 1939 में फिर से कांग्रेस अध्यक्ष पद के लिए खड़े होने का फैसला किया, तो महात्मा गांधी और रूढ़िवादी कार्य समिति द्वारा आधिकारिक तौर पर किस उम्मीदवार का समर्थन किया गया था?
o: Pattabhi Sitaramayya
Rajendra Prasad
J.B. Kripalani
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
e: Detailed Explanation: Gandhi and several veteran members of the working committee opposed Bose's re-election bid, favoring and actively supporting Pattabhi Sitaramayya as their candidate.

qe: By what exact statistical margin did Subhash Chandra Bose win the historic presidential election of January 1939 against his opponent?
qh: सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने जनवरी 1939 के ऐतिहासिक राष्ट्रपति चुनाव में अपने प्रतिद्वंद्वी के खिलाफ किस सटीक सांख्यिकीय अंतर से जीत हासिल की थी?
o: 1580 votes against 1377
1377 votes against 1041
500 votes against 200
1650 votes against 1100
e: Detailed Explanation: In the closely contested January 1939 presidential election, Subhash Chandra Bose secured a historic victory by polling 1580 votes against Pattabhi Sitaramayya's 1377 votes.

qe: Which political blocs provided comprehensive strategic support to Subhash Chandra Bose during his victorious 1939 presidential election campaign?
qh: सुभाष चंद्र बोस को उनके विजयी 1939 के राष्ट्रपति चुनाव अभियान के दौरान किन राजनीतिक गुटों ने व्यापक रणनीतिक समर्थन प्रदान किया था?
o: The Congress Socialist Party and the communists
The National Liberal Foundation and the Hindu Mahasabha
The conservative Aligarh school elites and the Shafi League
The Unionists of Punjab and the Southern Justice Party
e: Detailed Explanation: Bose's re-election bid was strongly reinforced by the radical left wing, receiving full voting and organizational support from the Congress Socialist Party and the communists.

qe: Following the defeat of his preferred candidate in January 1939, Mahatma Gandhi issued which famous personal declaration that transformed the election into an internal ideological deadlock?
qh: जनवरी 1939 में अपने पसंदीदा उम्मीदवार की हार के बाद, महात्मा गांधी ने कौन सी प्रसिद्ध व्यक्तिगत घोषणा जारी की, जिसने चुनाव को एक आंतरिक वैचारिक गतिरोध में बदल दिया?
o: Pattabhi’s defeat is my defeat
India is one vast prison-house
No government deserves respect which holds cheap the liberty of its subjects
The process of constitutional advance is determined by the need to attract collaborators
e: Detailed Explanation: Conceding Sitaramayya's electoral loss, Gandhi publicly declared that 'Pattabhi’s defeat is my defeat,' transforming the political scenario into a direct Gandhi-versus-Bose ideological issue.

qe: In March 1939, the highly tense annual Congress session took place at Tripuri. Where is this historic location situated in present-day geography?
qh: मार्च 1939 में, त्रिपुरी में अत्यधिक तनावपूर्ण वार्षिक कांग्रेस सत्र आयोजित हुआ था। वर्तमान भूगोल में यह ऐतिहासिक स्थान कहाँ स्थित है?
o: Near Jabalpur in Madhya Pradesh
Near Wardha in Maharashtra
Near Unnao in Uttar Pradesh
Near Ahmedabad in Gujarat
e: Detailed Explanation: The Tripuri session of the Indian National Congress took place in the Central Provinces, located near Jabalpur in present-day Madhya Pradesh.

qe: Why was the election of the Congress President considered a vital constitutional opportunity for the broader membership inside the party structure?
qh: कांग्रेस अध्यक्ष के चुनाव को पार्टी संरचना के भीतर व्यापक सदस्यता के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण संवैधानिक अवसर क्यों माना जाता था?
o: Because the Working Committee was nominated by the President, making the election an expression of the membership's preference for leadership
Because the President held absolute legal power to unilaterally amend the British Government of India Act
Because it was the only elective office that determined the allocation of central budget grants to local bodies
Because it allowed the winning candidate to automatically bypass any legislative vetoes of the Viceroy
e: Detailed Explanation: Since the ruling body of the Congress (the Working Committee) was nominated by the President rather than elected, the presidential election served as the single constitutional channel through which the general membership could dictate the ideological direction of the leadership.

qe: What serious accusation did Subhash Chandra Bose level against the veteran leaders of the Working Committee prior to the Tripuri session, precipitating their mass resignations?
qh: त्रिपुरी सत्र से पहले सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने कार्य समिति के अनुभवी नेताओं पर कौन सा गंभीर आरोप लगाया था, जिससे उनका सामूहिक इस्तीफा हुआ?
o: He accused them of being ready to reach a compromise with the colonial government on the matter of federation
He accused them of misappropriating the collected capital inputs of the Tilak Swaraj Fund
He claimed they were secretly operating as armed paramilitary commanders for the Chapekar brothers
He accused them of trying to enforce the mandatory use of English instead of vernaculars inside village schools
e: Detailed Explanation: Deepening the inner crisis, Bose publicly accused the old-guard Working Committee leaders of being willing to compromise with the British government regarding the implementation of the federal structure under the 1935 Act. Offended by these statements, those leaders resigned.

qe: In his presidential speech at Tripuri, what profound geopolitical event did Subhash Chandra Bose correctly prophesy was about to take place in Europe?
qh: त्रिपुरी में अपने अध्यक्षीय भाषण में, सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने सही ढंग से किस गंभीर भू-राजनीतिक घटना की भविष्यवाणी की थी जो यूरोप में होने वाली थी?
o: An imperialist war was about to take place in Europe
The complete financial collapse of the British Parliament exchequer lines
The unilateral entry of the Soviet Union into a maritime trading treaty with Japan
The total legal dissolution of all monarchical kingdoms across continental Europe
e: Detailed Explanation: Although attending the Tripuri session while heavily ill, Bose delivered a presidential speech in which he correctly predicted that an international imperialist war was imminent in Europe.

qe: What specific tactical measure did Subhash Chandra Bose advocate presenting to the British government during his presidential speech at Tripuri to secure Swaraj?
qh: सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने त्रिपुरी में अपने अध्यक्षीय भाषण के दौरान स्वराज प्राप्त करने के लिए ब्रिटिश सरकार के सामने कौन सा विशिष्ट रणनीतिक उपाय रखने की वकालत की थी?
o: Submitting the national demand of independence to the British government in the form of an ultimatum
Filing a joint civil properties injunction lawsuit inside the central legislative council rooms
The immediate voluntary dissolution of all provincial Congress committees and ministries
Requesting the Privy Council in London to expand the non-official advisory seats under the 1935 Act
e: Detailed Explanation: Bose urged that the Congress must leverage the international crisis by presenting India's national demand for independence to the British government in the form of a clear, definitive ultimatum.

qe: What duration did Subhash Chandra Bose propose for the ultimatum to Britain, resolving to launch a mass civil disobedience movement if it was rejected?
qh: सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने ब्रिटेन को दिए जाने वाले अल्टीमेटम के लिए कितनी अवधि प्रस्तावित की थी, और इसके अस्वीकार होने पर एक सामूहिक सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन शुरू करने का संकल्प लिया था?
o: A six-month ultimatum
A one-year ultimatum
A two-year grace period
A three-month emergency window
e: Detailed Explanation: Bose advocated giving a strict six-month ultimatum to Great Britain to grant independence, proposing that a nationwide mass civil disobedience movement be launched immediately if the timeline expired without a positive response.

qe: Why did Mahatma Gandhi strongly oppose Subhash Chandra Bose's proposal to deliver an immediate ultimatum to the British government in 1939?
qh: महात्मा गांधी ने 1939 में ब्रिटिश सरकार को तत्काल अल्टीमेटम देने के सुभाष चंद्र बोस के प्रस्ताव का कड़ा विरोध क्यों किया था?
o: He believed that neither the Congress nor the masses were ready for struggle, citing communal discord and class strife
He was legally bound by the terms of the Gandhi-Irwin Pact to protect British war interests indefinitely
He firmly believed that the Morley-Minto reforms fully satisfied all constitutional baseline demands
He sought to protect the economic profit margins of British managing agencies operating in coastal ports
e: Detailed Explanation: Gandhi rejected the ultimatum line because he felt the country was unready for a mass movement, noting visible communal discord, class strife, and a lack of a unified national vision that would jeopardize any immediate struggle.

qe: Which prominent leader moved a historic resolution at Tripuri that reaffirmed faith in Gandhian policies and mandated the President to nominate the Working Committee accordingly?
qh: किस प्रमुख नेता ने त्रिपुरी में एक ऐतिहासिक प्रस्ताव पेश किया जिसने गांधीवादी नीतियों में विश्वास दोहराया और राष्ट्रपति के लिए उसी के अनुसार कार्य समिति को नामित करना अनिवार्य बना दिया?
o: Govind Ballabh Pant
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
Rajendra Prasad
Pattabhi Sitaramayya
e: Detailed Explanation: Govind Ballabh Pant moved the controversial resolution at Tripuri, which re-emphasized complete faith in Gandhian principles and specifically directed Bose to select the members of the Working Committee in accordance with Gandhi's wishes.

qe: The 'Pant Resolution' at Tripuri was passed without opposition from the socialists or the communists. What did this reflect regarding the Left's strategic alignment?
qh: त्रिपुरी में 'पंत प्रस्ताव' समाजवादियों या कम्युनिस्टों के विरोध के बिना पारित हो गया था। इसने वामपंथ के रणनीतिक झुकाव (strategic alignment) के संबंध में क्या दर्शाया?
o: The Left was not keen on discarding Mahatma Gandhi's essential national leadership
The leftists had completely abandoned their belief in socialist and Marxist ideologies
They aimed to dissolve the Congress platform to fully integrate with the All India Muslim League
The Left held an absolute majority inside the non-elected Chamber of Princes
e: Detailed Explanation: The passage of the Pant Resolution proved that despite supporting Bose in the election, the Left wing was not ready to break away from or discard Mahatma Gandhi's crucial leadership of the broader national movement.

qe: Why did the socialists and the communists for the most part refuse to support Subhash Chandra Bose to the point of causing an absolute split within the Indian National Congress?
qh: समाजवादियों और कम्युनिस्टों ने अधिकांशतः सुभाष चंद्र बोस का उस सीमा तक समर्थन करने से क्यों इनकार कर दिया जिससे भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के भीतर एक पूर्ण विभाजन हो जाता?
o: They realized that a split would reduce the un-consolidated Left to a minor splinter group and undermine the national struggle
They were financially dependent on the capital grant subsidies provided by the British War Cabinet
They were legally forced by an injunction of the central Legislative Assembly to support Rajendra Prasad
They believed that the varna system was completely sinful and required immediate armed annihilation
e: Detailed Explanation: Leftist groups recognized that their forces were not fully consolidated. They calculated that causing an institutional split within the Congress would reduce the Left to a minor splinter group and weaken the Congress, which was the primary vehicle of the anti-imperialist struggle.

qe: Faced with an absolute ideological deadlock and unable to win Gandhi's confidence or nominate a Working Committee, in which month and year did Subhash Chandra Bose resign from the post of Congress President?
qh: पूर्ण वैचारिक गतिरोध का सामना करने और गांधी का विश्वास जीतने या कार्य समिति को नामित करने में असमर्थ होने पर, सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने किस महीने और वर्ष में कांग्रेस अध्यक्ष पद से इस्तीफा दे दिया था?
o: April 1939
January 1939
March 1939
August 1939
e: Detailed Explanation: Seeing no alternative way to resolve the structural impasse or bridge his differences with Gandhi, Subhash Chandra Bose resigned from the presidency of the Congress in April 1939.

qe: Following the historic resignation of Subhash Chandra Bose in April 1939, who was elected as the new President to overcome the inner crisis of the Indian National Congress?
qh: अप्रैल 1939 में सुभाष चंद्र बोस के ऐतिहासिक इस्तीफे के बाद, भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के आंतरिक संकट को दूर करने के लिए किसे नया अध्यक्ष चुना गया था?
o: Rajendra Prasad
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
J.B. Kripalani
Maulana Abul Kalam Azad
e: Detailed Explanation: To resolve the leadership vacuum and steady the party machinery after Bose's resignation, Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected as the Congress President in April 1939.

qe: In May 1939, Subhash Chandra Bose and his radical followers established a new factional party within the broader framework of the Congress. What was its name and where was it founded?
qh: मई 1939 में, सुभाष चंद्र बोस और उनके कट्टरपंथी अनुयायियों ने कांग्रेस के व्यापक ढांचे के भीतर एक नए गुटीय दल की स्थापना की। इसका नाम क्या था और इसकी स्थापना कहाँ हुई थी?
o: Forward Bloc, founded at Makur, Unnao
Independence League, founded at Haripura, Gujarat
Naujawan Bharat Sabha, founded at Ferozshah Kotla, Delhi
Swarajya Sabha, founded at Wardha, Maharashtra
e: Detailed Explanation: In May 1939, Bose and his loyalists formed a specialized platform within the Congress infrastructure named the Forward Bloc, formally launched at Makur in the Unnao district of Uttar Pradesh.

qe: What provocative step taken by Subhash Chandra Bose in July 1939 against an official AICC resolution directly compelled the Working Committee to initiate strict disciplinary action against him?
qh: जुलाई 1939 में सुभाष चंद्र बोस द्वारा एक आधिकारिक एआईसीसी प्रस्ताव के खिलाफ उठाए गए किस उकसावे वाले कदम ने कार्य समिति को उनके खिलाफ सख्त अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई शुरू करने के लिए मजबूर किया था?
o: He gave a public call for an all-India protest on July 9
He ordered the immediate armed picketing of all provincial ministries
He forcefully seized the documented capital inputs of the National Planning Committee
He filed a direct property lawsuit inside the Calcutta High Court rooms against Rajendra Prasad
e: Detailed Explanation: Defying party lines, Bose organized a public call for a synchronized all-India protest on July 9 against an official resolution of the All India Congress Committee (AICC), prompting immediate disciplinary measures.

qe: In August 1939, the Congress Working Committee executed a severe disciplinary penalty against Subhash Chandra Bose. What was the nature of this penalty?
qh: अगस्त 1939 में, कांग्रेस कार्य समिति ने सुभाष चंद्र बोस के खिलाफ एक गंभीर अनुशासनात्मक दंड लागू किया। इस दंड की प्रकृति क्या थी?
o: He was removed from the post of president of the Bengal Provincial Congress Committee and debarred from holding any elective office in the Congress for three years
He was permanently excommunicated from entering any district within British India for life
His registered political journal 'Harijan' was summarily seized and its printing press liquidated
He was handed over to a special three-judge panel of the High Court to face a sedition trial
e: Detailed Explanation: In August 1939, the CWC penalized Bose by removing him from his position as president of the Bengal Provincial Congress Committee and legally debarring him from contesting or holding any elective post within the Congress for a fixed duration of three years.

qe: A survey routing pathway tracks a right-angled triangular configuration. A vehicle drives 24 km North from station O, and then shifts orientation to move 10 km East to reach checkpoint B. Find the direct straight-line distance from O to B.
qh: एक कार स्टेशन O से 24 किमी उत्तर की ओर चलती है, और फिर दिशा बदलकर पूर्व की ओर 10 किमी जाकर चेकपॉइंट B पर पहुँचती है। O से B की सीधी रेखा की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
o: 26 km
34 km
28 km
30 km
e:
Detailed Explanation: This spatial movement sets up a right-angled triangle with perpendicular legs of 24 km and 10 km. The direct straight-line distance represents the hypotenuse.
By applying the Pythagoras theorem: $\text{Distance} = \sqrt{24^2 + 10^2} = \sqrt{576 + 100} = \sqrt{676} = \mathbf{26\text{ km}}$.

qe: In a biological ecosystem productivity tracking survey mapping energy parameters, if the Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) of an alluvial marsh plain is 35,000 units and the energy lost during plant metabolic respiration (R) is 15,000 units, calculate the Net Primary Productivity (NPP).
qh: ऊर्जा मापदंडों का मानचित्रण करने वाले एक पारिस्थितिकी उत्पादकता सर्वेक्षण में, यदि एक मैदानी क्षेत्र की सकल प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (GPP) 35,000 इकाइयाँ है और पौधों के श्वसन (R) के दौरान खर्च की गई ऊर्जा 15,000 इकाइयाँ है, तो शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (NPP) की गणना करें।
o: 20,000 units
50,000 units
15,000 units
30,000 units
e:
Detailed Explanation: Utilizing the core ecological productivity balance formula: $NPP = GPP - R$.
Substituting the values: $NPP = 35,000 - 15,000 = \mathbf{20,000\text{ units}}$.

qe: Sardar Patel, Rajendra Prasad, and J.B. Kripalani argued against Bose's view of the presidency by asserting that the position of the Congress President structurally served what primary role?
qh: सरदार पटेल, राजेंद्र प्रसाद और जे.बी. कृपलानी ने राष्ट्रपति पद के संबंध में बोस के दृष्टिकोण का विरोध करते हुए दावा किया कि कांग्रेस अध्यक्ष का पद संरचनात्मक रूप से किस प्राथमिक भूमिका को पूरा करता था?
o: It was more of a constitutional post, representative and symbolic of the unity of the nation
It was an absolute dictatorial office equipped with direct veto powers over all provincial list charts
It functioned strictly as an intermediate financial accounting office managing the home charges bills
It was a lifetime hereditary title reserved exclusively for Western-educated barristers of Calcutta
e: Detailed Explanation: Defending traditional norms, Patel and other working committee leaders argued that programs were developed collectively in bodies like the working committee, and the President's post was a constitutional, representative position symbolic of national unity.

qe: In his analytical view written later, why did Subhash Chandra Bose believe that the international crisis of 1939 was the absolute optimum time to strike against British imperialism?
qh: बाद में लिखे गए अपने विश्लेषणात्मक दृष्टिकोण में, सुभाष चंद्र बोस का यह क्यों मानना था कि 1939 का अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संकट ब्रिटिश साम्राज्यवाद के खिलाफ प्रहार करने का बिल्कुल उपयुक्त समय था?
o: He believed the Congress was structurally strong enough and the masses were completely ready for such a struggle
He calculated that the British exchequer was totally bankrupt and unable to deploy any police forces
He believed that the separate communal electorates framework had successfully unified all rural ryots
He felt that the Viceroy's executive council would voluntarily surrender all its powers without a fight
e: Detailed Explanation: Bose's radical strategy was anchored on a confident assessment of mass readiness. He maintained that the Congress possessed sufficient structural strength and that the public was fully prepared to launch a final mass civil disobedience campaign to wrest independence while Britain was vulnerable during the European crisis.
